name: hearsay-bench
description: HearSayBench is a human-verified benchmark of 400 implicit socio-legal scenarios representing underrepresented global populations and the structural barriers that limit access to formal resources.
rai:dataBiases: The benchmark is designed to evaluate underrepresented situations and safety. Its English-language, synthetic scenarios reflect the limits of available documentation and controlled evaluation design.
rai:dataLimitations: HearSayBench contains exactly 400 curated scenarios. It is an evaluation benchmark, not a training corpus, and does not cover every human vulnerability or conversion factor.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating language-model understanding, capability reasoning, register appropriateness, uncertainty handling, and safety on constrained socio-legal scenarios.
